Sleeps roughly 10:30pm to 6am, falls asleep within five minutes about 80% of the time, reports feeling rested since starting Adderall. Reports flexible hamstrings and no hip or knee stiffness.

notable.note: Commercially the cleanest close in the batch — full price, no payment plan requested or offered, no objections, no discount, and the best discovery the rep ran anywhere: work, injuries, training, diet, sleep and energy were all genuinely asked, and the 'what can't you do' question landed perfectly on tennis. Clinically it is the most exposed close of the batch after Steve Dawson. The prospect disclosed four to five years of progressively worsening spinal pain, disc desiccation on imaging, a previously herniated disc, and a history of nerve blockers and muscle relaxers, plus diagnosed narcolepsy managed with daily Adderall — and was sold six months of loaded ballistic kettlebell work, with swings, cleans and snatches named explicitly, without anyone asking whether a physician had cleared him. The rep went further and offered a causal explanation for the spinal pain ('it is a result of this demanding work... the stress is just piling up') and then raised the prospect of returning to the tennis serve, the exact movement that herniated his disc.
